claims.text: The Models page pins jev-1.13.0 at $42/BTok ($0.042/MTok) input with free outputs, 250k tok/s + 1200 req/min limits, 64k request context (32k state + longest question), text-only input, and jev-latest/jev-preview aliases both resolving to 1.13.0.
claims.context: Docs page fully consumed this pass.

claims.text: Alias drift is explicitly warned: answers behind an alias can change without customer-side changes; the response model field reports the versioned ID for threshold logging.
claims.context: First-party versioning semantics; material to evaluation-validity.

claims.text: Jev is not fine-tuned per customer; RLCD-calibrated shared weights serve all accounts with domain shaping via state/instructions/criteria.
claims.context: Training/serving facts per page; RLCD internals undisclosed.

limitations.text: Behavioral compliance with documented limits untested independently.
